companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Italian; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: Buongiorno. A greeting and your name, please. We have standards. Mostly structural.
lines.translation: Good morning. A greeting and your name, please. We have standards. Mostly structural.
lines.narrative: The archway clears her throat. A visitors’ book slides from her keystone, already disappointed by the lack of paperwork.

lines.native: Ciao! A perfectly acceptable greeting. Now, come ti chiami? The visitors’ book cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.translation: Hello! A perfectly acceptable greeting. Now, what is your name? The visitors’ book cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. The name field remains blank, an administrative tragedy in miniature.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam. Your introduction is officially accepted. Now, a question about me would be polite. I am architecture, not an anonymous service provider.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Your introduction is officially accepted. Now, a question about me would be polite. I am architecture, not an anonymous service provider.
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam in the visitors’ book. Her pen hovers over a second column, labelled ‘Evidence of Reciprocal Manners.’

lines.native: Mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! Your question was perfectly polite. Puoi entrare. I shall record this as a normal interaction. Nothing to get emotional about.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! Your question was perfectly polite. You may enter. I shall record this as a normal interaction. Nothing to get emotional about.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the keystone. Portia turns a page rather quickly, as though the question has not delighted her at all. The market entrance opens.

objective_results.feedback: Introduce yourself using an Italian first-person expression and your name.
Ask Portia her name in Italian, or ask her 'and you?' using the Italian informal pronoun.
